import json, random, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np
import genhard, check

def run(reqs):
    data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
    return p.stdout.decode().splitlines()

worst=0.0; worstreq=None
rng=random.Random(1234)
for it in range(6):
    reqs=[genhard.gen_request(rng) for _ in range(60)]
    lines=run(reqs)
    for req,line in zip(reqs,lines):
        resp=json.loads(line)
        if resp["status"]!="optimal": continue
        d=check.build(req)
        x=[]
        for fl in resp["flows"]:
            x.extend(fl)
        x=np.array(x)
        mig=float(np.sum(np.abs(x-np.array(d["a"]))))
        slack=mig-2.0*req["budget"]
        if slack>worst:
            worst=slack; worstreq=(req,line)
        # equality residual
        er=0.0
        for k in range(d["K"]):
            s=sum(x[j] for j in range(d["P"]) if d["owner"][j]==k)
            er=max(er,abs(s-d["demands"][k]))
        if er>1e-9: print("equality residual",er)
print("worst migration-row excess: %.3g" % worst)
if worstreq: print(json.dumps(worstreq[0])[:400]); print(worstreq[1][:300])
PYEOF
